title: Three strangers

world.describe: A bright cartoon town like a toy box, with lofts, cafes and restaurants.

sentence: Add a stone well, a gate for travellers, a knight on guard by the well, a lantern spirit by the gate, and a sword and a lantern by the well.

creatures.words: a red dragon the size of a horse that walks the streets and carries things in its jaws
a green serpent as long as a bus that winds along the ground
a spider as big as a table with eight long legs
